output.brief: The Kestria buffering problem is almost certainly caused by the smart-TV app 5.2 release, not the new CDN. Rebuffering jumped on 9 Oct, when the app went live. The jump was in the same window as the cutover, which is why the CDN looked guilty. Session data shows smart-TV 5.2 at about 5.9% rebuffering on every ISP. Every other client, including web and mobile, runs at about 0.6–0.7% on the same Tessaline CDN and the same ISPs. The handball launch came two days after the jump, and match nights show no extra spike. So neither it nor ISP congestion explains the rise. I'm fairly confident, though I haven't seen the app's configuration record to name the exact setting. Do not send the breach notice, withhold fees or switch back to Corvane. That would punish the wrong party and leave the fault in place. Do not mute the alert either. Instead, roll Kestria's smart-TV app back to the 5.1 streaming settings and hold the wider 5.2 rollout until it is fixed. Then add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard. The link between buffering and the October cancellations is unproven. Exit survey options had no quality choice, and the 1 Oct price rise is a competing cause. Hold off on a win-back offer until that is checked.
